newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London up, Sony firm.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London up, Sony firm.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London were mostly firmer on Wednesday with banks and Sony Corp leading the way, dealers said.
Industrial Bank of Japan and Mitsubishi Trust & Banking Corp were among the strongest of the banking stocks and the sector as a whole was firm, dealers said.
Sony Corp was trading around 10,570 yen by the London close, up 70 yen from its Tokyo closing level.
"There has been a lot of interest in Sony, it is very much in vogue again. It has been helped by the strength in its ADRs in the U.S.," one dealer said.
"Overall there's a pretty firm tone to the market," he said.
The Nikkei 50 index closed at 1,685.20, up 8.96 points or 0.53 percent from Tuesday's London close. In Tokyo, the Nikkei 225 climbed 289 points to 20,358.74.
